name: Bayern Munich 2019/20 (Flick)
scopeNote: Bayern Munich under Hansi Flick only: first match 6 Nov 2019 (2-0 vs Olympiacos, Champions League; FourFourTwo 2019-11-06 describes him as interim boss; Kovac sacked Sunday 3 Nov after 5-1 at Frankfurt) to the Champions League final win over PSG on 23 Aug 2020 (the DFB-Pokal final vs Leverkusen was 4 July 2020). Flick was interim, then confirmed permanently in December 2019. Kovac's earlier 2019/20 matches excluded. Style is named by sources as high defensive line plus gegenpressing (StatsBomb 'gegenpressing', BFW 'high line press'); a 4-2-3-1 in possession, 4-4-2/4-1-4-1 pressing shape. Not tiki-taka/Guardiola positional play, though 360Player notes Guardiola influence on build-up. No source found for set-piece marking scheme (zonal vs man) in this period; open-play pressing is described as 'almost man to man' (360Player, tier C) and 'marked comprehensively' (Kimmich via StatsBomb). Coaches' Voice Coach Watch (2020/21) is not used for verification here because it covers 2020/21.
openQuestions: Manager file hansi-flick.json says first match 9 Nov vs Dortmund; sources here show 6 Nov vs Olympiacos (first match as interim) and 9 Nov was his first Bundesliga match.
Zonal vs man marking at set pieces in 2019/20 not found; only the corner offside-squeeze (BFW) and 'almost man to man' open-play pressing (360Player, tier C).

fcbayerncentral (tier D) describes Kimmich and Davies as full-backs in a 2-3-5, contradicting Coaches' Voice (Pavard and Davies full-backs, Kimmich/Goretzka pivot) and BFW final (Kimmich at right-back in the final only).
Starting XI: StatsBomb 4-1-4-1 out of possession vs Coaches' Voice 4-2-3-1 in possession; likely same team seen in two phases, not reconciled by a single source.
Squad age/average starting age for Flick's 2019/20 side not found; only Musiala/Davies/Zirkzee youth mentions in other files.
